items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: He's a big publisher. I got his name on a record back there. I haven't been paid for it, haven't collected for it.

ctx.x: What was he like and who was he?

He's a big publisher. I got his name on a record back there. I haven't been paid for it, haven't collected for it. I will if I take time. Any record you record, just like when I was with Lucky Millinder's band, if you want to make a record you write a tune. This is your tune. So the leader says, O.K. Got your arrangement and everything? After the record is printed, you look on that record, you see by Irving Mills and so and so and so. I got a record back there to show it.
Irving Mills, you said that he would put his name on the song, every song. Would you get any money from it? About how much from each record?
